rationale: Price is consolidating tightly in the $11.60-$11.63 range with declining volume on the last few candles, sitting just below the 9-EMA ($11.65) and near VWAP ($11.57) — no clear directional momentum. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.04%, VIXY +5.42%), which creates headwinds for a long, while the stock has already gapped up ~6.4% from prior close and is 73% through today's range, limiting short conviction as well. Without a clean breakout above the session high or a breakdown below VWAP, the risk/reward is insufficient to commit capital.
